before.test/documents_test.exs:
ExUnit.start()
defmodule DocumentsTest do
  use ExUnit.Case, async: true
  test "only the owner can delete an existing document" do
    {:ok, store} = Agent.start_link(fn -> %{1 => %{owner: :alice}} end)
    assert Documents.delete(store, 1, :bob) == {:error, :unauthorized}
  end
end

after.test/documents_test.exs:
ExUnit.start()
defmodule DocumentsTest do
  use ExUnit.Case, async: true
  use SharedAuthorizationCases, operation: &Documents.delete/3
end
